meta.title: Revelation From The Altar
meta.description: After overcoming the formidable obstacles in your path, the wisdom you seek lies in the shadows of the high tower.

units.rawText: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Labyrinth.
units.displayText: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Labyrinth.

spans.text: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Labyrinth.

units.rawText:
Densely-packed tentacle-like lifeforms coat the cramped walls. The savage maws on their tips seem to be looking at us and following our movements closely.
These strange entities extend and retract imperceptibly, as though bidding us a friendly greeting, or perhaps they're simply preparing for their next meal.
units.displayText:
Densely-packed tentacle-like lifeforms coat the cramped walls. The savage maws on their tips seem to be looking at us and following our movements closely.
These strange entities extend and retract imperceptibly, as though bidding us a friendly greeting, or perhaps they're simply preparing for their next meal.

spans.text:
Densely-packed tentacle-like lifeforms coat the cramped walls. The savage maws on their tips seem to be looking at us and following our movements closely.
These strange entities extend and retract imperceptibly, as though bidding us a friendly greeting, or perhaps they're simply preparing for their next meal.

units.rawText: After shaking off the sticky goo that's fallen onto my forearm, I once again check the integrity of the Spoof Code that's shrouding me, then run to catch up with Atlas as we head deeper into the filthy narrow path before us.
units.displayText: After shaking off the sticky goo that's fallen onto my forearm, I once again check the integrity of the Spoof Code that's shrouding me, then run to catch up with Atlas as we head deeper into the filthy narrow path before us.

spans.text: After shaking off the sticky goo that's fallen onto my forearm, I once again check the integrity of the Spoof Code that's shrouding me, then run to catch up with Atlas as we head deeper into the filthy narrow path before us.

units.rawText: The frontline forces intel department plotted so many paths; do we HAVE to take this one?
units.displayText: The frontline forces intel department plotted so many paths; do we HAVE to take this one?

spans.text: The frontline forces intel department plotted so many paths; do we HAVE to take this one?

units.rawText: Of course! Don't you trust my instincts? I honed this sensitivity through long days of battle with the Entropics; you couldn't stop praising it back then.
units.displayText: Of course! Don't you trust my instincts? I honed this sensitivity through long days of battle with the Entropics; you couldn't stop praising it back then.

spans.text: Of course! Don't you trust my instincts? I honed this sensitivity through long days of battle with the Entropics; you couldn't stop praising it back then.

units.rawText: Even with all the obstructions between us, I can sense that our target's ahead of us!
units.displayText: Even with all the obstructions between us, I can sense that our target's ahead of us!

spans.text: Even with all the obstructions between us, I can sense that our target's ahead of us!

units.rawText: Well done! So tell me, why did we almost go on the wrong path without my reminder?
units.displayText: Well done! So tell me, why did we almost go on the wrong path without my reminder?

spans.text: Well done! So tell me, why did we almost go on the wrong path without my reminder?

units.rawText: ...Ahem! We all make mistakes, so it is best not to quibble about bugs. I mean, my little mistake helped you show how reliable you were, isn't that right, buddy?
units.displayText: ...Ahem! We all make mistakes, so it is best not to quibble about bugs. I mean, my little mistake helped you show how reliable you were, isn't that right, buddy?

spans.text: ...Ahem! We all make mistakes, so it is best not to quibble about bugs. I mean, my little mistake helped you show how reliable you were, isn't that right, buddy?

units.rawText: Trust me, it'll be okay this time!
units.displayText: Trust me, it'll be okay this time!

spans.text: Trust me, it'll be okay this time!
Alright, I believe you!
...Really?

units.rawText: Hahahaha! Good, that's more like it!
units.displayText: Hahahaha! Good, that's more like it!

spans.text: Hahahaha! Good, that's more like it!

units.rawText: Since you've said as much, I've got to meet your expectations. Leave all the remaining problems to me!
units.displayText: Since you've said as much, I've got to meet your expectations. Leave all the remaining problems to me!

spans.text: Since you've said as much, I've got to meet your expectations. Leave all the remaining problems to me!

units.rawText: Why do I feel like we've gone the long way around instead?
units.displayText: Why do I feel like we've gone the long way around instead?

spans.text: Why do I feel like we've gone the long way around instead?

units.rawText: As the saying goes, the long way is the shortest way! We'll be there soon!
units.displayText: As the saying goes, the long way is the shortest way! We'll be there soon!

spans.text: As the saying goes, the long way is the shortest way! We'll be there soon!

units.rawText: Although, you don't look too good, buddy... Is it the aftereffects of the firewall?
units.displayText: Although, you don't look too good, buddy... Is it the aftereffects of the firewall?

spans.text: Although, you don't look too good, buddy... Is it the aftereffects of the firewall?

units.rawText: No... It's nothing; it's just that this environment makes me a little uncomfortable.
units.displayText: No... It's nothing; it's just that this environment makes me a little uncomfortable.

spans.text: No... It's nothing; it's just that this environment makes me a little uncomfortable.

units.rawText: I look around. The things on the walls seem alive, and the idea of being observed by those alien creatures turns my stomach.
units.displayText: I look around. The things on the walls seem alive, and the idea of being observed by those alien creatures turns my stomach.

spans.text: I look around. The things on the walls seem alive, and the idea of being observed by those alien creatures turns my stomach.

units.rawText: Don't worry. I'll have to get used to this place eventually when operating in Tartarus. Let's keep moving.
units.displayText: Don't worry. I'll have to get used to this place eventually when operating in Tartarus. Let's keep moving.

spans.text: Don't worry. I'll have to get used to this place eventually when operating in Tartarus. Let's keep moving.

units.rawText: So it's those Daemons acting up! I won't let them affect you, buddy!
units.displayText: So it's those Daemons acting up! I won't let them affect you, buddy!

spans.text: So it's those Daemons acting up! I won't let them affect you, buddy!

units.rawText: Atlas grabs the handle of his greatsword and gathers his strength.
units.displayText: Atlas grabs the handle of his greatsword and gathers his strength.

spans.text: Atlas grabs the handle of his greatsword and gathers his strength.

units.rawText: Let's settle things quickly, in the most brutal way!
units.displayText: Let's settle things quickly, in the most brutal way!

spans.text: Let's settle things quickly, in the most brutal way!

units.rawText: Wait, don't—
units.displayText: Wait, don't—

spans.text: Wait, don't—

units.rawText: Before I can stop him, Atlas is already swinging his greatsword at the Labyrinth wall.
units.displayText: Before I can stop him, Atlas is already swinging his greatsword at the Labyrinth wall.

spans.text: Before I can stop him, Atlas is already swinging his greatsword at the Labyrinth wall.

units.rawText: A small force field appears, drowning the Entropic creatures' cries within the transparent barrier.
units.displayText: A small force field appears, drowning the Entropic creatures' cries within the transparent barrier.

spans.text: A small force field appears, drowning the Entropic creatures' cries within the transparent barrier.

units.rawText: Aw, I took out the Entropics on the wall, but I guess you can't bust through the labyrinth walls with a weak attack like that... Sorry, buddy.
units.displayText: Aw, I took out the Entropics on the wall, but I guess you can't bust through the labyrinth walls with a weak attack like that... Sorry, buddy.

spans.text: Aw, I took out the Entropics on the wall, but I guess you can't bust through the labyrinth walls with a weak attack like that... Sorry, buddy.

units.rawText: As I look at Atlas' cheerful smile, I can't help but sigh.
units.displayText: As I look at Atlas' cheerful smile, I can't help but sigh.

spans.text: As I look at Atlas' cheerful smile, I can't help but sigh.

units.rawText: ...Let's keep a low profile. Alcyone and Electra are launching a diversion so we can sneak around, after all.
units.displayText: ...Let's keep a low profile. Alcyone and Electra are launching a diversion so we can sneak around, after all.

spans.text: ...Let's keep a low profile. Alcyone and Electra are launching a diversion so we can sneak around, after all.

units.rawText: Hahahaha, relax, buddy. I still remember the basics of stealth. Can't be leaving myself unguarded out there, you know.
units.displayText: Hahahaha, relax, buddy. I still remember the basics of stealth. Can't be leaving myself unguarded out there, you know.

spans.text: Hahahaha, relax, buddy. I still remember the basics of stealth. Can't be leaving myself unguarded out there, you know.

units.rawText: Still, I have to say that although the Entropics aren't much of a threat, the traps here are all nasty as hell. There's no honor in the way they fight.
units.displayText: Still, I have to say that although the Entropics aren't much of a threat, the traps here are all nasty as hell. There's no honor in the way they fight.

spans.text: Still, I have to say that although the Entropics aren't much of a threat, the traps here are all nasty as hell. There's no honor in the way they fight.

units.rawText: Atlas scratches his head and puts his weapon away.
units.displayText: Atlas scratches his head and puts his weapon away.

spans.text: Atlas scratches his head and puts his weapon away.

units.rawText: Ahhhh, if only I had enough operands! No matter how complicated the terrain was, I could just cut right through it.
units.displayText: Ahhhh, if only I had enough operands! No matter how complicated the terrain was, I could just cut right through it.

spans.text: Ahhhh, if only I had enough operands! No matter how complicated the terrain was, I could just cut right through it.

units.rawText: Given the strength of your attack just now, the labyrinth walls are thick and hard enough that you'd need siege weaponry to break them down.
units.displayText: Given the strength of your attack just now, the labyrinth walls are thick and hard enough that you'd need siege weaponry to break them down.

spans.text: Given the strength of your attack just now, the labyrinth walls are thick and hard enough that you'd need siege weaponry to break them down.

units.rawText: And then, leaving aside whether or not there are any defense mechanisms in store, once the maze shifts, wouldn't all your efforts be wasted?
units.displayText: And then, leaving aside whether or not there are any defense mechanisms in store, once the maze shifts, wouldn't all your efforts be wasted?

spans.text: And then, leaving aside whether or not there are any defense mechanisms in store, once the maze shifts, wouldn't all your efforts be wasted?

units.rawText: Hahaha, Eosphorus must have thought of that, too. I'll listen to you then; let's stick to the plan.
units.displayText: Hahaha, Eosphorus must have thought of that, too. I'll listen to you then; let's stick to the plan.

spans.text: Hahaha, Eosphorus must have thought of that, too. I'll listen to you then; let's stick to the plan.

units.rawText: Atlas laughs and takes off his cape. He then drapes it over me before pulling the hood up over my head.
units.displayText: Atlas laughs and takes off his cape. He then drapes it over me before pulling the hood up over my head.

spans.text: Atlas laughs and takes off his cape. He then drapes it over me before pulling the hood up over my head.

units.rawText: I'm sure Sanctifiers like you and Eosphorus will lead us to victory.
units.displayText: I'm sure Sanctifiers like you and Eosphorus will lead us to victory.

spans.text: I'm sure Sanctifiers like you and Eosphorus will lead us to victory.

units.rawText: The clean white fabric keeps the omnipresent stares at bay, and even the air becomes clearer.
units.displayText: The clean white fabric keeps the omnipresent stares at bay, and even the air becomes clearer.

spans.text: The clean white fabric keeps the omnipresent stares at bay, and even the air becomes clearer.

units.rawText: Feeling better?
units.displayText: Feeling better?

spans.text: Feeling better?

units.rawText: Yeah, very much so. Thanks.
units.displayText: Yeah, very much so. Thanks.

spans.text: Yeah, very much so. Thanks.

units.rawText: Aw, why so stiff? I pledged to protect you before I set out. A man's promise has to be kept no matter what!
units.displayText: Aw, why so stiff? I pledged to protect you before I set out. A man's promise has to be kept no matter what!

spans.text: Aw, why so stiff? I pledged to protect you before I set out. A man's promise has to be kept no matter what!

units.rawText: Just hang in there. Once we get the Rubik's Map, we'll be able to take a better route into the Middle Ring!
units.displayText: Just hang in there. Once we get the Rubik's Map, we'll be able to take a better route into the Middle Ring!

spans.text: Just hang in there. Once we get the Rubik's Map, we'll be able to take a better route into the Middle Ring!

units.rawText: The Rubik's Map... With it, we ought to be able to figure out how the Shifting Labyrinth works, right?
units.displayText: The Rubik's Map... With it, we ought to be able to figure out how the Shifting Labyrinth works, right?

spans.text: The Rubik's Map... With it, we ought to be able to figure out how the Shifting Labyrinth works, right?

units.rawText: Yes, anything wrong with that?
units.displayText: Yes, anything wrong with that?

spans.text: Yes, anything wrong with that?

units.rawText: There's just one thing I don't understand... It's about the Rubik's Map; does it really exist? I'm not doubting the truth of this mission or the intel we got, but it just doesn't make sense to me.
units.displayText: There's just one thing I don't understand... It's about the Rubik's Map; does it really exist? I'm not doubting the truth of this mission or the intel we got, but it just doesn't make sense to me.

spans.text: There's just one thing I don't understand... It's about the Rubik's Map; does it really exist? I'm not doubting the truth of this mission or the intel we got, but it just doesn't make sense to me.

units.rawText: Let's say there is an item that displays the condition of the entire Labyrinth in real-time, including its shifting. What use would it have to the Entropics of Tartarus?
units.displayText: Let's say there is an item that displays the condition of the entire Labyrinth in real-time, including its shifting. What use would it have to the Entropics of Tartarus?

spans.text: Let's say there is an item that displays the condition of the entire Labyrinth in real-time, including its shifting. What use would it have to the Entropics of Tartarus?

units.rawText: Who knows about the Entropics? The Clerics have been bashing their heads against that particular topic for a long time now, but they still have no idea what's going on with them.
units.displayText: Who knows about the Entropics? The Clerics have been bashing their heads against that particular topic for a long time now, but they still have no idea what's going on with them.

spans.text: Who knows about the Entropics? The Clerics have been bashing their heads against that particular topic for a long time now, but they still have no idea what's going on with them.

units.rawText: What if the Entropics have absolutely no sense of direction at all and need to check the map whenever they want to go home?
units.displayText: What if the Entropics have absolutely no sense of direction at all and need to check the map whenever they want to go home?

spans.text: What if the Entropics have absolutely no sense of direction at all and need to check the map whenever they want to go home?

units.rawText: Hm...
units.displayText: Hm...

spans.text: Hm...

units.rawText: (Sigh) Look buddy, I was just messing with you, don't take it so seriously!
units.displayText: (Sigh) Look buddy, I was just messing with you, don't take it so seriously!

spans.text: (Sigh) Look buddy, I was just messing with you, don't take it so seriously!

units.rawText: I know what you're worried about, and frankly speaking I thought it was weird when you pointed it out, but why think so much about it?
units.displayText: I know what you're worried about, and frankly speaking I thought it was weird when you pointed it out, but why think so much about it?

spans.text: I know what you're worried about, and frankly speaking I thought it was weird when you pointed it out, but why think so much about it?

units.rawText: Whatever it is, let's just get our hands on it first. Even if it's a trap, retreating from the Outer Ring isn't going to be that hard.
units.displayText: Whatever it is, let's just get our hands on it first. Even if it's a trap, retreating from the Outer Ring isn't going to be that hard.

spans.text: Whatever it is, let's just get our hands on it first. Even if it's a trap, retreating from the Outer Ring isn't going to be that hard.

units.rawText: Atlas smiles again and pats my shoulder with a smile.
units.displayText: Atlas smiles again and pats my shoulder with a smile.

spans.text: Atlas smiles again and pats my shoulder with a smile.

units.rawText: You've got to make progress with your feet, not your head. Everything will be clear once we find the map, whether they're traps or secrets.
units.displayText: You've got to make progress with your feet, not your head. Everything will be clear once we find the map, whether they're traps or secrets.

spans.text: You've got to make progress with your feet, not your head. Everything will be clear once we find the map, whether they're traps or secrets.

units.rawText: ...You have a point...
units.displayText: ...You have a point...

spans.text: ...You have a point...

units.rawText: Indeed. So don't think so much about it, just relax and follow me. We ought to be there soon...
units.displayText: Indeed. So don't think so much about it, just relax and follow me. We ought to be there soon...

spans.text: Indeed. So don't think so much about it, just relax and follow me. We ought to be there soon...

units.rawText: —Hold it!
units.displayText: —Hold it!

spans.text: —Hold it!

units.rawText: Atlas' jovial attitude vanishes in an instant and he holds his arm out in front of me.
units.displayText: Atlas' jovial attitude vanishes in an instant and he holds his arm out in front of me.

spans.text: Atlas' jovial attitude vanishes in an instant and he holds his arm out in front of me.

units.rawText: Discordant hissing and growling comes from up ahead, around the left corner.
units.displayText: Discordant hissing and growling comes from up ahead, around the left corner.

spans.text: Discordant hissing and growling comes from up ahead, around the left corner.

units.rawText: Several seconds later, a horde of Entropics emerge from around the bend and approach us, shoving each other and squirming forward in turn.
units.displayText: Several seconds later, a horde of Entropics emerge from around the bend and approach us, shoving each other and squirming forward in turn.

spans.text: Several seconds later, a horde of Entropics emerge from around the bend and approach us, shoving each other and squirming forward in turn.
(Give Atlas a command.)

options.rawText: (Wait for Atlas to make a move.)
options.displayText: (Wait for Atlas to make a move.)

spans.text: (Wait for Atlas to make a move.)

units.rawText: Keep quiet and hug the walls.
units.displayText: Keep quiet and hug the walls.

spans.text: Keep quiet and hug the walls.

units.rawText: I look at the writhing, organic tendrils on the walls. Their rows of circular teeth look razor-sharp. I gulp and gesture to Atlas to get close.
units.displayText: I look at the writhing, organic tendrils on the walls. Their rows of circular teeth look razor-sharp. I gulp and gesture to Atlas to get close.

spans.text: I look at the writhing, organic tendrils on the walls. Their rows of circular teeth look razor-sharp. I gulp and gesture to Atlas to get close.

units.rawText: The mixture of two different sensations—sticky and sharp—press against my body. But that's not all. The dizzying smell engulfs me like a breath and bright red warning messages flash in my eyes.
units.displayText: The mixture of two different sensations—sticky and sharp—press against my body. But that's not all. The dizzying smell engulfs me like a breath and bright red warning messages flash in my eyes.

spans.text: The mixture of two different sensations—sticky and sharp—press against my body. But that's not all. The dizzying smell engulfs me like a breath and bright red warning messages flash in my eyes.

units.rawText: Shhh, stay quiet.
units.displayText: Shhh, stay quiet.

spans.text: Shhh, stay quiet.

units.rawText: Just as he finishes speaking, Atlas shelters me behind his body and waits motionlessly for the Entropics to ooze past. A suffocating stench and sensation ooze over me and threaten to trigger an instinctive reaction from my systems.
units.displayText: Just as he finishes speaking, Atlas shelters me behind his body and waits motionlessly for the Entropics to ooze past. A suffocating stench and sensation ooze over me and threaten to trigger an instinctive reaction from my systems.

spans.text: Just as he finishes speaking, Atlas shelters me behind his body and waits motionlessly for the Entropics to ooze past. A suffocating stench and sensation ooze over me and threaten to trigger an instinctive reaction from my systems.

units.rawText: Deafening, bright red alerts blare in my ear; fortunately, the sights and sounds are masked by the Spoof Code and contained within my neural cloud.
units.displayText: Deafening, bright red alerts blare in my ear; fortunately, the sights and sounds are masked by the Spoof Code and contained within my neural cloud.

spans.text: Deafening, bright red alerts blare in my ear; fortunately, the sights and sounds are masked by the Spoof Code and contained within my neural cloud.

units.rawText: The Spoof Code only works at a distance. We won't be able to fool them if they get close...
units.displayText: The Spoof Code only works at a distance. We won't be able to fool them if they get close...

spans.text: The Spoof Code only works at a distance. We won't be able to fool them if they get close...

units.rawText: Don't worry, buddy. Just hide yourself. If they attack us, I'll take them all out without a sound.
units.displayText: Don't worry, buddy. Just hide yourself. If they attack us, I'll take them all out without a sound.

spans.text: Don't worry, buddy. Just hide yourself. If they attack us, I'll take them all out without a sound.

units.rawText: Atlas keeps his voice low and places a hand on his sword hilt. He keeps his eyes fixed on the Entropics as they slowly approach us.
units.displayText: Atlas keeps his voice low and places a hand on his sword hilt. He keeps his eyes fixed on the Entropics as they slowly approach us.

spans.text: Atlas keeps his voice low and places a hand on his sword hilt. He keeps his eyes fixed on the Entropics as they slowly approach us.

units.rawText: 100 meters... 80 meters... 50 meters...
units.displayText: 100 meters... 80 meters... 50 meters...

spans.text: 100 meters... 80 meters... 50 meters...

units.rawText: Get ready to fight...
units.displayText: Get ready to fight...

spans.text: Get ready to fight...

units.rawText: 20 meters... 10 meters...
units.displayText: 20 meters... 10 meters...

spans.text: 20 meters... 10 meters...

units.rawText: —Go!
units.displayText: —Go!

spans.text: —Go!

units.rawText: <size=40>—Kaboom!</size>
units.displayText: —Kaboom!

spans.text: —Kaboom!

units.rawText: Huh?
units.displayText: Huh?

spans.text: Huh?

units.rawText: A nearby explosion stops Atlas in his tracks as he watches the Entropics cease their advance. Atlas jams his half-drawn sword firmly back into its sheath.
units.displayText: A nearby explosion stops Atlas in his tracks as he watches the Entropics cease their advance. Atlas jams his half-drawn sword firmly back into its sheath.

spans.text: A nearby explosion stops Atlas in his tracks as he watches the Entropics cease their advance. Atlas jams his half-drawn sword firmly back into its sheath.

units.rawText: A brief pause later, the Entropics move toward the source of the sound as though they've received orders.
units.displayText: A brief pause later, the Entropics move toward the source of the sound as though they've received orders.

spans.text: A brief pause later, the Entropics move toward the source of the sound as though they've received orders.

units.rawText: It's fine, they're long gone.
units.displayText: It's fine, they're long gone.

spans.text: It's fine, they're long gone.

units.rawText: Whew—My heart was racing back there.
units.displayText: Whew—My heart was racing back there.

spans.text: Whew—My heart was racing back there.

units.rawText: You don't say, I almost had my sword out. Fortunately there was an explosion to distract them. Looks like luck was on our side, buddy!
units.displayText: You don't say, I almost had my sword out. Fortunately there was an explosion to distract them. Looks like luck was on our side, buddy!

spans.text: You don't say, I almost had my sword out. Fortunately there was an explosion to distract them. Looks like luck was on our side, buddy!

units.rawText: —What do you mean by luck? Our diversion was a success!
units.displayText: —What do you mean by luck? Our diversion was a success!

spans.text: —What do you mean by luck? Our diversion was a success!

units.rawText: Hm? Is that you, Ally?
units.displayText: Hm? Is that you, Ally?

spans.text: Hm? Is that you, Ally?

units.rawText: Atlas frantically brings up his communicator's viewscreen. The girl in the picture has a stern look on her face, but it doesn't hide the smugness there.
units.displayText: Atlas frantically brings up his communicator's viewscreen. The girl in the picture has a stern look on her face, but it doesn't hide the smugness there.

spans.text: Atlas frantically brings up his communicator's viewscreen. The girl in the picture has a stern look on her face, but it doesn't hide the smugness there.

units.rawText: We saw that you were in trouble, so Electra and I blew up an energy tower we found earlier to draw away the Entropics.
units.displayText: We saw that you were in trouble, so Electra and I blew up an energy tower we found earlier to draw away the Entropics.

spans.text: We saw that you were in trouble, so Electra and I blew up an energy tower we found earlier to draw away the Entropics.

units.rawText: You were nearly exposed back there, so you'd better thank us.
units.displayText: You were nearly exposed back there, so you'd better thank us.

spans.text: You were nearly exposed back there, so you'd better thank us.

units.rawText: Hahaha, so it was you helping us out, Ally. Thanks to the both of you!
units.displayText: Hahaha, so it was you helping us out, Ally. Thanks to the both of you!

spans.text: Hahaha, so it was you helping us out, Ally. Thanks to the both of you!

units.rawText: Energy tower? But you were at another location just now...
units.displayText: Energy tower? But you were at another location just now...

spans.text: Energy tower? But you were at another location just now...

units.rawText: Hehe, don't look down on our mobility. Reading the situation and responding quickly is a piece of cake for me even while I'm dragging Electra around. Right, Electra?
units.displayText: Hehe, don't look down on our mobility. Reading the situation and responding quickly is a piece of cake for me even while I'm dragging Electra around. Right, Electra?

spans.text: Hehe, don't look down on our mobility. Reading the situation and responding quickly is a piece of cake for me even while I'm dragging Electra around. Right, Electra?

units.rawText: ...Why are you lying down again, Electra?!
units.displayText: ...Why are you lying down again, Electra?!

spans.text: ...Why are you lying down again, Electra?!

units.rawText: Aw, I'm just maintaining a proper work-life balance. There's nothing else around and Ally's so capable, too. There's nothing wrong with me taking a nap for a bit, right~
units.displayText: Aw, I'm just maintaining a proper work-life balance. There's nothing else around and Ally's so capable, too. There's nothing wrong with me taking a nap for a bit, right~

spans.text: Aw, I'm just maintaining a proper work-life balance. There's nothing else around and Ally's so capable, too. There's nothing wrong with me taking a nap for a bit, right~

units.rawText: ...Humph!
units.displayText: ...Humph!

spans.text: ...Humph!

units.rawText: Speaking of which, since the number of Entropics in your area suddenly spiked, it's a sign that you're on the right track.
units.displayText: Speaking of which, since the number of Entropics in your area suddenly spiked, it's a sign that you're on the right track.

spans.text: Speaking of which, since the number of Entropics in your area suddenly spiked, it's a sign that you're on the right track.

units.rawText: If I'm not wrong, you'll be...
units.displayText: If I'm not wrong, you'll be...

spans.text: If I'm not wrong, you'll be...

units.rawText: While she's speaking, we arrive at the end of the road. After we turn the corner from which the Entropics came, the passage before us opens up.

units.rawText: A tower that extends well over the high walls nearby stands in front of us. It's covered in the usual Entropic goop that's everywhere, but it can't hide the architectural style that's dramatically different from the rest of the labyrinth.

units.rawText: The height is confirmed, and the external appearance is a 97% match for the objective.
units.displayText: The height is confirmed, and the external appearance is a 97% match for the objective.

spans.text: The height is confirmed, and the external appearance is a 97% match for the objective.

units.rawText: That's right, this is our destination; the Rubik's Map is in there. Ah, it's just like you said, Ally!
units.displayText: That's right, this is our destination; the Rubik's Map is in there. Ah, it's just like you said, Ally!

spans.text: That's right, this is our destination; the Rubik's Map is in there. Ah, it's just like you said, Ally!

units.rawText: It's all thanks to the route I picked! How about that, buddy? See how great my instincts are yet?
units.displayText: It's all thanks to the route I picked! How about that, buddy? See how great my instincts are yet?

spans.text: It's all thanks to the route I picked! How about that, buddy? See how great my instincts are yet?
They're awesome!
Let's get down to business.

units.rawText: Alright, <cmdr>, stop flattering Atlas and tell me about the situation. Where do you want the next diversion and how big should it be?

, stop flattering Atlas and tell me about the situation. Where do you want the next diversion and how big should it be?

, tell me about the situation. Where do you want the next diversion and how big should it be?

units.rawText: There are a few packs of Entropics in front of the building. I'm sending the info over to you now.

spans.text: There are a few packs of Entropics in front of the building. I'm sending the info over to you now.

units.rawText: No problem, nothing to it!

units.rawText: I've gotten your info. According to the coordinates, the Rubik Map is on... X-443.13, Y-axis is... Hm—got it!

needs our help, hehe.

units.displayText: Ack!

units.rawText: Beep—
units.displayText: Beep—

units.rawText:
After Alcyone drags Electra away, it isn't long before the Entropic horde in front of us stirs and leaves in a hurry.
Atlas and I seize the moment and warily approach the structure.

units.rawText: Say, buddy. Doesn't the architecture of this building look especially familiar?
units.displayText: Say, buddy. Doesn't the architecture of this building look especially familiar?

spans.text: Say, buddy. Doesn't the architecture of this building look especially familiar?

units.rawText: I thought I was imagining things, but when I took a closer look—it really does resemble a Watchtower! And here I thought the intelligence was just using it as a form of description.
units.displayText: I thought I was imagining things, but when I took a closer look—it really does resemble a Watchtower! And here I thought the intelligence was just using it as a form of description.

spans.text: I thought I was imagining things, but when I took a closer look—it really does resemble a Watchtower! And here I thought the intelligence was just using it as a form of description.
It does seem pretty suspicious.
It's no big deal.

units.rawText: To think there'd be a structure that looks like it was made by the Sanctifiers in the middle of the enemy's home base...
units.displayText: To think there'd be a structure that looks like it was made by the Sanctifiers in the middle of the enemy's home base...

spans.text: To think there'd be a structure that looks like it was made by the Sanctifiers in the middle of the enemy's home base...

units.rawText: Maybe the Sanctifiers of the past built it, and now it's been infected by the Entropy.
units.displayText: Maybe the Sanctifiers of the past built it, and now it's been infected by the Entropy.

spans.text: Maybe the Sanctifiers of the past built it, and now it's been infected by the Entropy.

units.rawText: Leaving that aside, there's a more pressing question.
units.displayText: Leaving that aside, there's a more pressing question.

spans.text: Leaving that aside, there's a more pressing question.

units.rawText: Why is it that they have no defenders here besides the Entropics outside?
units.displayText: Why is it that they have no defenders here besides the Entropics outside?

spans.text: Why is it that they have no defenders here besides the Entropics outside?

units.rawText: I look around and at the readings on the scanner in my hand. The readings indicate that the Entropic defenses here are abnormally weak.
units.displayText: I look around and at the readings on the scanner in my hand. The readings indicate that the Entropic defenses here are abnormally weak.

spans.text: I look around and at the readings on the scanner in my hand. The readings indicate that the Entropic defenses here are abnormally weak.

units.rawText: Doesn't that mean Alcyone and Electra drew all the enemies away? Okay, so maybe it's a little boring without fighting, but it's a good thing, too.
units.displayText: Doesn't that mean Alcyone and Electra drew all the enemies away? Okay, so maybe it's a little boring without fighting, but it's a good thing, too.

spans.text: Doesn't that mean Alcyone and Electra drew all the enemies away? Okay, so maybe it's a little boring without fighting, but it's a good thing, too.

units.rawText: Considering the importance of this place, I doubt the Entropics stationed here would have been lured away so easily...
units.displayText: Considering the importance of this place, I doubt the Entropics stationed here would have been lured away so easily...

spans.text: Considering the importance of this place, I doubt the Entropics stationed here would have been lured away so easily...

units.rawText: Come on, look on the bright side, buddy! It just means Alcyone and Electra did a great job!
units.displayText: Come on, look on the bright side, buddy! It just means Alcyone and Electra did a great job!

spans.text: Come on, look on the bright side, buddy! It just means Alcyone and Electra did a great job!

units.rawText: Think about it, the enemies we've met along the way here are far below standard numbers, right? The only thing giving us problems were the traps. It's all thanks to them.
units.displayText: Think about it, the enemies we've met along the way here are far below standard numbers, right? The only thing giving us problems were the traps. It's all thanks to them.

spans.text: Think about it, the enemies we've met along the way here are far below standard numbers, right? The only thing giving us problems were the traps. It's all thanks to them.

units.rawText: Hm... As much as I'd like to stay positive, we should continue advancing carefully.

spans.text: Hm... As much as I'd like to stay positive, we should continue advancing carefully.

units.rawText: Atlas and I enter the Watchtower, keeping a wary eye on our surroundings. Since the internal layout is similar to what we're familiar with, we easily make it to the core area.

units.rawText: The platform that ought to hold a power supply unit instead has a containment device there. Within it is a silver polyhedral visible through the glass, so close but yet so far away. Its unwavering radiance seems to be complaining about our tardiness.
units.displayText: The platform that ought to hold a power supply unit instead has a containment device there. Within it is a silver polyhedral visible through the glass, so close but yet so far away. Its unwavering radiance seems to be complaining about our tardiness.

units.displayText: So that's what the Rubik's Map looks like. Pretty neat.

units.rawText: Well, can you deal with it?
units.displayText: Well, can you deal with it?

spans.text: Well, can you deal with it?

units.rawText: It shouldn't be a problem... I think.
units.displayText: It shouldn't be a problem... I think.
